items.title: War update: 202 combat engagements on front line over past day
items.teaser: On October 12, Ukraine's Defense Forces recorded 202 combat engagements with Russian forces along the front line.

items.title: ADF neutralizes 88 Russian drones used to attack Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 88 drones used by Russian forces to attack the country from the evening of October 12.

items.title: Raketenangriff auf Charkiw: drei Menschen tot aus den Trümmern geborgen, 10 weitere verletzt
items.teaser: Im Cholodnohirskyj Bezirk von Charkiw sind Leichen von drei Personen aus den Trümmern eines Hauses, das von einer russischen Rakete getroffen wurde, geborgen, teilt der Bürgermeister der Stadt Ihor Terechow auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Polen: Festnahmen in Deutschland nach Brand an Starlink-Station
items.teaser: Nach dem Brand an einer Starlink-Station in Polen gibt es Festnahmen in Deutschland. Polens Regierung vermutet Russland hinter der Sabotageaktion.

items.title: Russian drone attack at medical facility in Khmelnytskyi region leaves four patients injured
items.teaser: Four patients at a medical facility in Khmelnytskyi region were injured in a Russian drone attack.

items.title: Drone debris falls on private property in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district
items.teaser: Debris from a Russian drone fell on the grounds of a private residential property in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with ballistic missiles, Banderol drone missiles and 108 drones: air defences downs 88 UAVs
items.teaser: Russia launched five ballistic missiles, nine drone missiles and 108 drones from the evening of 12 October. Ukrainian air defences reported impacts at 17 locations and fallen debris at seven others.

items.title: Tusk: Zwei mutmaßliche Saboteure in Deutschland festgenommen
items.teaser: Am 23.

items.title: Russian attack damages medical facility in Khmelnytskyi Oblast, injuring four patients
items.teaser: Russian drone attacks on 12 October damaged windows and the entrance to a healthcare facility as well as nearby parked cars. Four patients receiving treatment sustained minor injuries.

items.title: Russia loses another 1,390 troops in one day in war against Ukraine.
items.teaser: Russia’s total estimated combat losses since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, reached approximately 1,555,700 personnel as of October 13, 2026, including 1,390 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Drone attack damages houses and cars in Lviv region
items.teaser: Two houses caught fire after a downed Russian drone crashed into a residential building in a village in the Lviv region.

items.title: Russians attack Dnipro: man injured, residential building and transport infrastructure facility damaged – photos
items.teaser: A Russian morning strike shattered windows in apartment blocks and damaged cars and a transport infrastructure facility. A man received medical treatment but declined hospitalisation.

items.title: Three bodies found under rubble after Russian strike on Kharkiv – photos
items.teaser: Rescue teams are searching the rubble of a four-storey residential building in Kharkiv's Kholodnohirskyi district after a Russian strike on 12 October. A rescue worker was also injured and taken to hospital.

items.title: Injury toll from Russian missile strike on Kharkiv rises to 11
items.teaser: Eleven people were injured in a massive Russian attack on Kharkiv, and three people were rescued.

items.title: Chinesischer Satellit - Spionagemission gegen den Westen?
items.teaser: Ein chinesischer Spionagesatellit positioniert sich laut Recherchen von WDR, NDR und SZ in der Nähe eines westlichen Satelliten, der auch von der Bundeswehr genutzt wird. Militärs fürchten ein Ausspähen vertraulicher Kommunikation.

items.title: Massive Russian attack on Kharkiv: Eight injured, entrance section of residential building destroyed
items.teaser: Eight people were injured in Russian strikes on Kharkiv, and two were hospitalized in serious condition.

items.title: Russia loses 1,390 soldiers and 51 artillery systems over past day
items.teaser: Russia has lost 1,390 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day, bringing its total number of personnel losses to 1,555,700.

items.title: Trump comments on Russia's violation of energy truce
items.teaser: The US president believes that both Ukraine and Russia violated the energy truce he announced.

items.title: Trump: Putin will die Waffenruhe mehr als Selenskyj
items.teaser: US-Präsident Donald Trump beharrt darauf, dass zwischen der Ukraine und Russland eine Waffenruhe für Angriffe auf Energieanlagen gilt. Mutmaßliche Verstöße müsse er sich anschauen.

items.title: Russian drone attack damages houses and cars in Lviv Oblast
items.teaser: Two houses caught fire in Murovane after a downed Russian drone fell on a residential building. Three cars were also damaged, while emergency services responded at the scene.

items.title: Unexploded aerial bomb neutralized in Kharkiv region after hitting agricultural enterprise
items.teaser: Bomb disposal experts destroyed a 500-kilogram Russian guided aerial bomb that struck a building belonging to an agricultural enterprise in Katerynivka, Kharkiv region, but failed to detonate.

items.title: Trump says Ukraine, Russia agree to energy strike ceasefire 'because I said they agreed'
items.teaser: The U.S. president's comments came after he unilaterally announced an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine on Oct. 11, causing confusion in Kyiv. According to a senior Ukrainian official, Ukraine had no prior information about an energy ceasefire.

items.title: Merz opposes Trump's diesel deal with Putin and assures Zelensky of Germany's support
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has opposed the agreement between US President Donald Trump and Russian leader Vladimir Putin on Russian diesel fuel supplies, saying that Europe should instead increase pressure on Russia.

items.title: French Navy intercepts Russian shadow fleet tanker in Indian Ocean
items.teaser: The tanker DF Peak, previously named Kaliningrad, has falsely sailed under the flag of Benin and is sanctioned by the U.S, EU, Switzerland, Canada, and Japan.

items.title: Energy truce must be respected by both sides, says Kallas
items.teaser: The EU Foreign Affairs Council welcomes the idea of an energy ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia, but only on the condition that both sides respect it. Meanwhile, efforts to increase pressure on the aggressor state are continuing.

items.title: Another 11 children return to Ukrainian-controlled territory
items.teaser: Another 11 children have been returned to Ukrainian-controlled territory from temporarily occupied areas of the Kherson region.

items.title: “Run for Heroes” charity run in Chicago raises $10,000 for wounded Ukrainian soldiers
items.teaser: A charity run called “Run for Heroes” took place in Chicago, raising $10,000 to aid seriously wounded Ukrainian soldiers.

items.title: UK sanctions Dutch businessman exposed by Kyiv Independent for shipping EU machinery to Russian missile suppliers
items.teaser: The U.K. has sanctioned Alexander Tattersall, a Dutch national, and Redwing Metal, the Turkish company he co-owns, nearly four months after a Kyiv Independent investigation revealed the firm had funneled EU-made industrial machinery to Russian metallurgical plants that supply the country's missile and fighter jet manuf

items.title: Trump: Putin wants to reach deal more than Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Speaking to reporters at Joint Base Andrews, US President Donald Trump said Washington would push both leaders towards an agreement and argued that Ukraine's president should also want a deal.

items.title: Russian mines injure 1,739 civilians, including 178 children, since start of full-scale war
items.teaser: Since the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, 1,739 people, including 178 children, have been injured by enemy mines and explosive remnants of war.

items.title: Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv before sirens, gap that lands hard amid fears that Washington could cut data that warns of launches
items.teaser: The alert came late because Ukrainian radar detected the missiles only during the attack, with no advance data on launches, the Air Force says.

items.title: Russian missile attack on Kharkiv injures at least 11, including rescuer
items.teaser: A State Emergency Service rescuer was also injured while responding to the attack and was hospitalized, RBC-Ukraine reported, citing the emergency service. His condition was not immediately confirmed.

items.title: Polen: Zwei Festnahmen in Deutschland nach Brand an Starlink-Station
items.teaser: Nach dem Brand an einer Starlink-Station in Polen gibt es Festnahmen in Deutschland. Polens Regierung vermutet Russland hinter der Sabotageaktion.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1692: Trump suspends Russian diesel sanctions, while EU blacklists record 1,569 arms suppliers
items.teaser: Washington has suspended its new sanctions on Russian diesel, and bipartisan US senators say the deal conflicts with a 2022 ban and could help finance the war.

items.title: Macron says France intercepted sanctioned Russian tanker in Indian Ocean
items.teaser: President Emmanuel Macron has announced that French naval forces intercepted the Russian oil tanker DF Peak south of the island of Réunion due to false flag operations.

items.title: Kinzhal is 90% identical to Iskander-M: Ukraine’s intelligence identifies 58 companies in production chain
items.teaser: Russia is developing a modified version of the Kinzhal missile, equipped with a warhead that strikes targets with fragments and a blast wave.

items.title: Ukrainska Pravda demands investigation into Austrian police conduct after journalists' detention
items.teaser: Tkach is known in Ukraine for his investigations of high-level corruption. He alleged that the arrest could have been retaliation from subjects of his investigations, who could have manipulated Austrian authorities by filing a fake report.

items.title: Ukraine budget revenue shortfall reaches UAH 50 bln — Marchenko
items.teaser: Ukraine’s state budget fell short of UAH 50 billion in planned revenue over the first nine months of 2026, with UAH 32 billion of that gap recorded in August–September.

items.title: Russian attacks on Rivne and oblast: student accommodation and residential buildings damaged
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked Rivne and Rivne Oblast, damaging non-residential facilities, student accommodation and houses.

items.title: Russian forces strike Kharkiv with Banderol missiles, injuries reported
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked Kharkiv, targeting the city's Kholodnohirskyi district.

items.title: Ballistic missiles hit Kyiv without air-raid warning: Ukraine's Air Force says no launch information was received
items.teaser: Radar systems detected the missiles only as the attack was underway, the Air Force says. Russia also attacked Kharkiv with nine S8000 Banderol missile drones.

items.title: Russian forces attack Rivne, damage reported
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the city of Rivne on the evening of October 12, causing damage.

items.title: Death toll rises to two after strike on 25-storey building in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district
items.teaser: Another body has been found at the site where a Russian drone crashed in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district.

items.title: Zelensky: US has power and means to compel Russia to agree to real energy truce
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that the United States has the power and means to force Russia to agree to a genuine energy ceasefire.

items.title: Ukraine und USA in der Krise: Was folgt auf den Diesel-Deal mit Russland?
items.teaser: Donald Trump will den Kauf russischen Diesels erlauben, was im In- und Ausland kritisiert wird. Was ist der Grund für die Entscheidung des US-Präsidenten und was soll die Ukraine tun? Die DW hat mit Experten gesprochen.

items.title: Brand in Starlink-Station in Polen - Festnahmen in Deutschland
items.teaser: Ende September brennt eine Starlink-Station in Polen, die auch für die Ukraine wichtig ist. Jetzt wurden in Deutschland zwei Verdächtige festgenommen. Die polnische Regierung vermutet Russland hinter dem Vorfall.

items.title: Russian forces strike rescuers again in Sloviansk while they fight fire
items.teaser: Russian forces launched a second attack on rescuers in Sloviansk, Donetsk region, while they were extinguishing a fire caused by an earlier Russian strike.

items.title: Kyiv under missile attack before air raid alert issued
items.teaser: Kyiv Independent staff reported powerful blasts in central Kyiv, with air raid sirens and mobile notifications sounding only afterward.

items.title: Zelensky holds supreme Commander-in-Chief's Staff meeting: Ukraine's front-line positions strongest in long time
items.teaser: Following a meeting of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief's Staff, President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russia is suffering heavy losses every day, while Ukraine's positions on the front line are the strongest they have been in a long time.

items.title: The right to investigate suspicions does not imply the right to use any means necessary: Ukrainska Pravda's position
Air Assault Forces deny reports of Russian advance near sadky in Sumy region
items.teaser: Reports by the DeepState resource claiming that Russian forces had advanced near the village of Sadky in Sumy district are false.

items.title: Russians attack transport infrastructure facility in Zhytomyr region
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a transport infrastructure facility in the Korosten district of Ukraine’s Zhytomyr region on the afternoon of October 12.

items.title: Russische Drohne schlägt in 25-stöckiges Wohnhaus in Kyjiw ein: es gibt eine Tote und elf Verletzte
items.teaser: Durch einen russischen Drohnenangriff auf ein Wohnhochhaus im Darnytskyj Bezirk von Kyjiw ist eine Person getötet und elf weitere verletzt worden, teilt der Bürgermeister von Kyjiw, Vitali Klitschko, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia not complying with energy ceasefire as of now
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky received a briefing from the Ukrainian negotiating team that had returned from the United States.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Russian drones strike Kyiv morning and evening, kill woman, injure 14
items.teaser: Key developments on Oct. 12: Russian drone attacks throughout the day strike Kyiv apartment bloc, kill woman, injure 14 Russia strikes Roshen confectionery factory in Vinnytsia New interceptor drone destroys two Russian Geran-5 drones in first week, Fedorov says SBU detains 19-year-old suspected of plotting bomb attack

items.title: Ukraine moves to speed up privatization of state-owned assets
items.teaser: If passed, the bill could help alleviate bottlenecks the State Property Fund has repeatedly faced when trying to sell state-owned assets and help shore up funds for the state budget.

items.title: Selenskyj: Russland hält sich nicht an Waffenruhe
items.teaser: „Die Ukraine ist bereit, die vom US- Präsidenten angekündigte Energie- Waffenruhe zu garantieren, und Russland muss entsprechende Schritte unternehmen“, schreibt Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj auf Facebook nach einer Beratung mit dem ukrainischem Verhandlungsteam.

items.title: Russian drone strikes high-rise apartment building in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district
items.teaser: A Russian drone struck a 25-story residential building in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district.

items.title: Injury toll after Russian strike on Kharkiv apartment building rises to 23
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian drone strike on a high-rise apartment building in Kharkiv has risen to 23, including two children.

items.title: Fabrik für Schmierstoffe nahe Kyjiw durch russische Drohnenangriffe zerstört
items.teaser: Infolge russischer Drohnenangriffe sind Produktionsstätten des Unternehmens „KSM PROTEK“, das auf die Herstellung von Schmierstoffen spezialisiert war, komplett zerstört.

items.title: Angry at Trump's Russian diesel deal? Here's how you can help Ukraine bomb Russia
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump had a busy weekend, undermining sanctions on Russia, blaming Ukraine for the war Russia started — again — and insisting that Russian refineries become drone-free zones. "We said you could do whatever you want to Russia, don't hit the refineries , because that&

items.title: Russia strikes Roshen confectionery factory in Vinnytsia
items.teaser: "The corporation's enterprises produce confectionery products and do not manufacture drones or other products for military purposes. The production complex in Vinnytsia is a civilian facility," the company said.

items.title: Vienna prosecutors say eyewitness accounts led to journalist Mykhailo Tkach's arrest. UP demands answers
items.teaser: Austrian prosecutors say eyewitness accounts led them to suspect three Ukrainians of conspiring to act as a group, but they later released journalists Mykhailo Tkach and Yaroslav Bondarenko. Ukrainska Pravda has questioned how the third-party information was verified.

items.title: Kein Zutritt für Tillschneider: Kontroverse nach Vorfall in Halle
items.teaser: Beim Gedenken an die Opfer des Anschlags von Halle war Landtags-Vize Hans-Thomas Tillschneider (AfD) der Zutritt zur Synagoge verwehrt worden. Das Thema hat hohe Wellen geschlagen. Politredakteur Engin Haupt ordnet ein.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region more than 40 times in one day, killing one and injuring six
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the city of Dnipro and the surrounding region more than 40 times throughout the day, killing one person and injuring six others.

items.title: “Zelenskyy is helping Democrats”: Trump’s MAGA base accuses Ukraine of trying to swing US midterms, says journalist in US
items.teaser: The narrative runs across all levels of the US information space, from anonymous accounts to national television.

items.title: Mehrere Verletzte nach russischen Angriffen in Dnipro und Pawlohrad
items.teaser: In Dnipro und Pawlohrad ist die Zahl der Verletzten durch russische Angriffe gestiegen, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Oleksandr Hanzha, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Ukraine's negotiating team briefs Zelenskyy on talks with Trump envoys
items.teaser: Ukraine’s negotiating team has briefed Zelenskyy on its meeting with Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff in the US. Zelenskyy and his negotiators have also discussed further diplomatic steps and a framework for de-escalation.

items.title: EU-Außenminister: Sanktionspaket mit willkommener Nebenwirkung
items.teaser: Noch nie hat die EU auf einen Schlag so viele Personen und Organisationen wegen des Kriegs gegen die Ukraine auf eine Sanktionsliste gesetzt wie heute. Dass das wie eine Antwort auf Trump wirkt, war nicht geplant, ist aber willkommen. Von K. Schmid.

items.title: Russian forces attack Roshen confectionery factory's production complex in Vinnytsia
items.teaser: On October 12, Russian forces attacked the production complex of the Roshen confectionery factory in Vinnytsia.

items.title: Russia’s sabotage of Europe should bring Ukraine more weapons through US purchase scheme, with clear statement of where its red lines lie, NATO’s top European commander says
items.teaser: The PURL program lets allies fund US-made weapons for Ukraine and drew nearly $5.5 billion in pledges before May.

items.title: Explainer: What top Zelensky staffer's bail saga tells us about Ukraine's justice system
items.teaser: The release from custody of Iryna Mudra, a former head of the President’s Office, last week followed an unusual development. While Ukrainians had been previously accustomed to corruption suspects easily escaping justice, now the trend was the opposite. Mudra had the money to pay the bail but banks

items.title: Russian drone hits apartment block in Kyiv: injuries reported
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an apartment block in Kyiv with a drone on the evening of 12 October, injuring several people.

items.title: Russian attack on Hlukhiv leaves two people injured
items.teaser: Two people were injured in a Russian attack on the city of Hlukhiv in Sumy region.

items.title: Poland investigates alleged plot to kill prime minister, his deputy
items.teaser: "We are taking this matter very seriously," National Defense Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz said at a press briefing on Oct. 11.

items.title: Built by Ukraine’s ex-defense minister and unit that wrecked $12 billion of Russian gear, new interceptor downs two jet drones over Kyiv
items.teaser: Mykhailo Fedorov and Lasar’s Group commander Pavlo Yelizarov developed the drone in a month, Fedorov says.

items.title: Selenskyj: letzte Nacht griffen wir keine Energieanlagen an, Russland hingegen nahm Tankstellen und Energieanlagen in der Ukraine ins Visier
items.teaser: Die Ukraine hat in der vergangenen Nacht keine Energieanlagen in Russland angegriffen, während Russland Tankstellen, Energieinfrastruktur und andere Objekte attackiert hat, sagte Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj in einem Interview mit Fox News.

items.title: Burnham: Iran wohl verantwortlich für Militärbasis-Vorfall
items.teaser: Mehrere Männer werden verdächtigt, einen Anschlag auf einen Militärstützpunkt in Großbritannien geplant zu haben.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine attacks no energy facilities last night, while Russia struck petrol stations and energy infrastructure
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine did not attack any energy facilities in Russia last night, while Russian forces targeted petrol stations, energy infrastructure, and other facilities in Ukraine.

items.title: All EU member states agree to open negotiating clusters 2 and 3 for Ukraine
items.teaser: Ireland’s European Affairs Minister Thomas Byrne says EU countries have agreed to advance accession talks with Ukraine and Moldova, while also closing negotiating chapters for Montenegro and Albania on 13 October.

items.title: Hungarian PM reacts to Ukraine's adoption of amendments to law on education for national minorities
items.teaser: Péter Magyar thanked those involved in the negotiations after Ukraine approved amendments that ease native-language education for Hungarian children in Zakarpattia Oblast.

items.title: Finland prepared to build large-scale fortifications on border with Russia
items.teaser: Former Finnish military intelligence chief Pekka Toveri says Finland relies on its terrain and climate for defence and can quickly assemble fortifications from prefabricated elements if the security situation deteriorates.

items.title: New interceptor drone destroys two Russian Geran-5 drones in first week, Fedorov says
items.teaser: The successful test comes as Ukrainian cities are under repeated assault from Russia's new generation of jet-powered drones.

items.title: Russia is building satellite network that could put all of Europe in reach, defense executive warns
items.teaser: Oleksandr Danyliuk, head of the European defense-tech firm Destinus, called Russia’s Rassvet system an extraordinary threat, first to Ukraine and then to Europe.

items.title: Russian drone attacks destroy lubricant manufacturing plant in Kyiv region
items.teaser: Russian drone attacks have destroyed the production facilities of KSM PROTEC, a Ukrainian company specializing in the manufacture of lubricants, in Kyiv region.

items.title: Russians print images of artworks stolen from art museum on electricity bills in occupied Kherson Oblast
items.teaser: In the occupied parts of Kherson Oblast, Russians have begun printing images of artworks stolen from the Oleksii Shovkunenko Kherson Regional Art Museum on electricity bills, accompanied by propagandistic historical notes.

items.title: EU is planning to maintain isolation of Russia and Belarus in global sports, chief diplomat says
items.teaser: The European External Action Service (EEAS) and the European Commission will prepare proposals to prevent the return of Russian and Belarusian athletes to international competitions.

items.title: Zelenskyy signs education law amendments sought by Hungary to unblock Ukraine's EU accession talks
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has signed amendments to the education law, which Hungary had demanded as a condition for agreeing to open negotiating clusters 2 and 3 in Ukraine’s EU accession talks.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Ukraine did not strike overnight, while Russia hit gas stations and energy infrastructure
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that Ukraine did not attack any energy facilities in Russia overnight, while Russia continued to strike Ukrainian infrastructure.

items.title: Selenskyj warnt vor Hungergefahr durch Blockade der Seewege durch Russland
items.teaser: Die Blockade der Seewege durch Russland könne bereits in ein bis zwei Monaten eine Ernährungskrise in Ländern Afrikas, Asiens und des Nahen Ostens auslösen, sagte der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj beim Warschauer Sicherheitsforum.

items.title: Ukraine struck 12 Russian oil refineries in September, Defence Ministry says
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defence Ministry says the strikes also hit five military-industrial complex facilities, including a drone manufacturer and a plant involved in Kh-59 missile production.

items.title: Mutige Wette oder Verzweiflungstat? : KI-Agenten sollen 2028 in BMW-Chefetage aufsteigen
items.teaser: Noch ist der Vorstand des BMW-Konzerns unter sich, wenn er über die Zukunft des Autobauers berät. Doch nicht mehr lange: Das Unternehmen plant, KI-Agenten einzubinden, und zwar auf höchster Ebene. Entscheidungen sollen so wesentlich schneller fallen.

items.title: BDI beklagt "Schutzlücke" : Geheimdienste warnen vor russischen Mordanschlägen auf Firmenchefs
items.teaser: Mordanschläge auf Zivislisten waren selbst für russische Agenten in ihrem hybriden Krieg gegen Deutschland bislang ein Tabu. Dies ändere sich, warnen Geheimdienste. Im Fokus des russischen Militärgeheimdienstes stünden inzwischen auch Unternehmenschefs. Der Industrieverband BDI fordert mehr Schutz.

items.title: Russian forces attack Lozova in Kharkiv region with drones: Woman killed, seven others injured
items.teaser: Russian forces have again attacked the city of Lozova in Kharkiv region, killing a woman and injuring seven other people, including a child.

items.title: Trump defends diesel deal with Putin, saying he did it "for the American People"
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump has sought to justify his deal with Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin to purchase Russian diesel.

items.title: Bipartisan US senators say Trump’s Russian diesel deal conflicts with 2022 ban, as he presses Kyiv to spare Russian refineries
items.teaser: The administration says the deal will lower fuel prices, but lawmakers warn it could help finance Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: Russia attacks six Ukrainian energy facilities today, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky believes it is becoming increasingly clear that Russia does not want to agree to the energy ceasefire proposed by the United States. Today alone, Russian forces attacked six energy facilities in Ukraine, and 33 people were injured across the country.

items.title: SPD-Beben, Rekord-Sanktionen und der Wirtschaftsnobelpreis
items.teaser: Bärbel Bas tritt als SPD-Chefin und Arbeitsministerin zurück, große Sanktionsrunde im Ukraine-Krieg und der Wirtschaftsnobelpreis.

items.title: For years, Hungary tied Ukraine’s whole EU course to ethnic Hungarians’ language rights. Kyiv has now passed the schooling law meant to lift the block
items.teaser: Hungary had blocked four stages of Ukraine’s membership process over the matter.

items.title: SBU detains 19-year-old suspected of plotting bomb attack on bus full of soldiers
items.teaser: The SBU said it had foiled a series of alleged terrorist plots prepared by Russian intelligence services in Rivne this year. Previous alleged plots targeted a park area and administrative buildings in the city center.

items.title: Terrorverdacht an US-Basis in England: Männer festgenommen, Kfz gesichert, Sperrkreis eingerichtet
items.teaser: Der mutmaßliche Terrorplan auf dem Militärstützpunkt Fairford ist nach Einschätzung der britischen Regierung sehr wahrscheinlich vom Iran koordiniert und von dessen Revolutionsgarden gesteuert worden. Alle Entwicklungen im Ticker.

items.title: EU blacklists 1,569 Russian arms suppliers and their bosses in its biggest sanctions round ever, as Trump eases up on Moscow
items.teaser: Most of the listed firms feed the supply chain behind the ballistic missiles Russia fires at Ukrainian cities, and EU ministers vowed to keep up the pressure despite the US-Russia fuel arrangement.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine could hold elections if Russia agrees to 60-day ceasefire. Moscow counters with truce lasting only voting day
items.teaser: Spokesperson Dmitry Peskov says Ukraine needs the 60 days not to hold elections but to heal its wounds and keep fighting.

items.title: Russian drone strikes civilian infrastructure facility in Vinnytsia
items.teaser: At around 15:40, an enemy drone struck a civilian infrastructure facility in Vinnytsia.

items.title: EU approves €115m defence innovation grant programme open to Ukraine
items.teaser: The European Union has established the AGILE programme with a budget of €115 million to support innovative defence projects by small and medium-sized enterprises. Ukrainian companies will be able to participate.

items.title: Europe has 11 ways to choke Russia’s war. It doesn’t need Trump’s permission for any of them
items.teaser: Three weeks after signing new Russia sanctions into law, Washington suspended them for Russian diesel, while the levers that would hurt Moscow most sit in European hands.

items.title: Russians attack Vinnytsia: reports emerge of strike on confectionery factory
items.teaser: Russia has attacked civilian infrastructure in Vinnytsia. Users on social media suggest a possible hit on a Roshen confectionery factory, but there has been no official confirmation.

items.title: Russen beschießen Dorf im Gebiet Donezk mit Mehrfachraketenwerfer: drei Menschen getötet, darunter eine 13-Jährige
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben ein privates Wohnhaus im Dorf Tscherkasske im Gebiet Donezk mit dem Mehrfachraketenwerfer „Smertsch“ beschossen. Drei Menschen wurden getötet, darunter ein 13-jähriges Mädchen. Vier weitere Personen wurden verletzt.

items.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: Von "Energie-Waffenruhe" keine Spur
items.teaser: US-Präsident Trump verkündete am Sonntag eine "Energie-Waffenruhe" zwischen der Ukraine und Russland - offenbar ohne Rückendeckung aus Moskau. Denn die Angriffe auf die ukrainische Energieinfrastruktur gehen unvermindert weiter. Von N. Bula.

items.title: Ten years on, Britain’s prime minister says Russia meddled in the Brexit vote—and warns Germany and France
items.teaser: In 2020, London said it saw “no evidence of successful interference.” Now Andy Burnham says Merz told him the AfD is linked to Russia.

items.title: Russia is hacking cameras across Europe to track arms bound for Ukraine. At home, Ukraine has secured about 40,000 that could guide strikes — WSJ
items.teaser: In 2024, Russian hackers seized residential webcams in Kyiv, according to Ukraine’s Security Service.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Kyiv leaves two kindergartens damaged
items.teaser: Two preschool facilities in Kyiv were damaged in a Russian drone attack.

items.title: Lithuanian PM suggests Allies ask Ukraine to strike more Russian data centres
items.teaser: Lithuanian Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevičius believes that Ukraine's allies should ask President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to strike more data centres in Russia.

items.title: From London to Sumy: thank you for standing with Kordon.Media
items.teaser: Dear supporters, We made it! In just one evening in London, you raised £9,855 for Kordon.Media, a news outlet from Sumy, a region bordering Russia. These funds will help Kordon prepare for the upcoming winter and keep reporting from Sumy and the surrounding region amid Russia’

items.title: Drone debris damages monument to freedom fighters in Ivano-Frankivsk – photos
items.teaser: Debris from a jet-powered drone damaged a monument to freedom fighters during a Russian attack on Ivano-Frankivsk on 11 October.

items.title: EU's Kos welcomes amendments to education law and says negotiating clusters for Ukraine will open on 13 October
items.teaser: Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos has welcomed Ukraine’s amendments to national minority education, which met a key Hungarian condition for advancing EU accession talks.

items.title: Russian forces strike Donetsk region settlement with Smerch MRLS, killing three, including 13-year-old girl
items.teaser: In the Donetsk region, Russian forces struck a private house in the settlement of Cherkaske with a Smerch multiple rocket launcher system, killing three people, including a 13-year-old girl. Four others were injured.

items.title: Vier Verletzte nach russischem Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw, zwei Kitas beschädigt
items.teaser: „Stand 15 Uhr 20 ist die Zahl der Verletzten nach den heutigen feindlichen Angriffen auf 4 gestiegen", teilt die Kyjiwer Militärverwaltung, via Telegram mit.

items.title: Woman killed and seven people injured in Russian strike on Lozova – photos
items.teaser: One person has been killed and seven others, including a child, have been injured as a result of a Russian strike on the city of Lozova in Kharkiv Oblast.

items.title: Ukrainian drones hit three of Russian tech giant Yandex’s data centers in four days. Ukraine’s president says the bots thinned out too
items.teaser: Lithuania’s prime minister wants more such strikes to protect elections. Researchers say the bot data shows Yandex’s web crawlers, not trolls.

items.title: US weapons supplies to Ukraine via PURL continue – NATO source
items.teaser: NATO has confirmed that the supply of weapons and ammunition from the United States to Ukraine through the PURL mechanism is continuing amid recent statements by Donald Trump.

items.title: Injury toll after Russian attack on Kyiv rises to four
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian attack on Kyiv has increased to four.

items.title: Verfassungsschutz warnt: „Langfristige“ russische Angriffe
items.teaser: Das Bundesamt für Verfassungsschutz (BfV) rechnet mit einer Fortsetzung verdeckter Angriffe und Destabilisierungsaktionen Russlands gegen Deutschland und andere europäische Staaten.

items.title: Russia targets residential buildings and energy infrastructure: Koretskyi reports 22 injured in Kharkiv
items.teaser: Overnight and in the morning of October 12, Russian forces attacked residential buildings, energy facilities, logistics and railway infrastructure, and farms in several regions. In Kharkiv, 22 people were reported injured.

items.title: 1739 Minenopfer in der Ukraine seit Kriegsbeginn, darunter 178 Kinder
items.teaser: Seit Beginn der Volliinvasion Russlands sind 1.739 Personen in der Ukraine durch Minen und explosive Kriegsreste verletzt worden, darunter 178 Kinder, teilt die Nationale Minenräumungsbehörde auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Peacekeepers, riot police, and drone crews: Russia’s bloc rehearses an operation in a Belarusian oblast bordering two NATO states
items.teaser: Police and national guard units train alongside soldiers from five former Soviet states, under priorities Russia set as the bloc’s chair this year.

items.title: Ukraine's Sybiha tells Lavrov he's earned a front-row seat at Special Tribunal
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has said in response to comments by Sergei Lavrov that representatives of the Kremlin regime deserve to be put on trial for their war crimes against Ukraine.

items.title: Russian attacks completely destroy lubricant plant in Kyiv Oblast
items.teaser: A plant belonging to KSM Protec, a Ukrainian lubricant manufacturer, has been destroyed as a result of a series of consecutive Russian drone attacks over the weekend.

items.title: Debris from Russian drone falls in Kyiv's Pecherskyi district
items.teaser: Debris from a Russian unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) caught fire near a building in the Pecherskyi district of the capital. The fire was quickly extinguished.

items.title: Hungary welcomes Ukraine's adoption of amendments to education law
items.teaser: Hungarian Foreign Minister Anita Orbán has welcomed the Ukrainian parliament’s adoption of amendments to the education law, describing the move as the result of months of dialogue and cooperation.

items.title: Can South Korea and Ukraine resolve their diplomatic spat over North Korean POWs?
items.teaser: Seoul and Kyiv are trading accusations after the transfer of two North Korean POWs to South Korea. The South insists the move was to be kept secret as it seeks to avoid antagonizing Pyongyang.

items.title: Family with child killed in Russian rocket artillery strike on Cherkaske in Donetsk Oblast
items.teaser: Three people, including a child, have been killed and four others injured as a result of Russian strikes on the settlement of Cherkaske in Donetsk Oblast on the morning of 12 October.

items.title: 'A miracle that Dad didn't die today' — Russian daytime drone attack on Kyiv injures at least three
items.teaser: "I'm in shock... I don't know how to carry on. We're all exhausted," Kyiv resident Sheremet Yuliia told the Kyiv Independent as the Russian strike on Ukraine's capital injured her father and severely damaged her house.

items.title: New Ukrainian interceptor drone has brought down two jet-powered Geran-5s, former defence minister says
items.teaser: Former defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov has said a new Ukrainian interceptor drone shot down two jet-powered Geran-5s heading to Kyiv within a month of development.

items.title: Russian drone strikes bus station in Zaporizhzhia, damaging vehicles
items.teaser: On the afternoon of October 12, Russian forces attacked transport infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia twice. One person was injured, and several vehicles were damaged.

items.title: Russische Drohne schlägt in Autobahnhof von Saporischscja ein: mehrere Fahrzeuge beschädigt
items.teaser: Am 12. Oktober hat das russische Militär zweimal die Verkehrsinfrastruktur von Saporischschja angegriffen. Eine Person wurde verletzt, mehrere Fahrzeuge beschädigt.

items.title: Ukrainian defence tech company Phantom Defense acquires anti-drone net developer, unveils counter-UAV system – photos, videos
items.teaser: Ukrainian defence tech company Phantom Defense has acquired Karakurt, a developer of anti-drone nets, along with its team, and unveiled its new Manhal counter-UAV system.

items.title: Russians strike Sloviansk three times with Smerch MLRS, woman injured
items.teaser: On October 12, Russian forces launched three strikes with Smerch multiple rocket launchers against a residential area of Sloviansk, injuring a 77-year-old woman.

items.title: Woman injured and 44 houses damaged in Russian rocket artillery strike on Sloviansk
items.teaser: An elderly woman was injured when Russian forces struck a residential area in Sloviansk, Donetsk Oblast, with a Smerch multiple-launch rocket system.

items.title: Ministerpräsident: Russland greift Wohnhäuser und Energieanlagen an. Zahl der Verletzten in Charkiw steigt auf 22
items.teaser: In der Nacht und am Morgen des 12. Oktober griffen die Russen Wohnhäuser, Energieanlagen, Logistik- und Eisenbahninfrastruktur sowie landwirtschaftliche Betriebe in mehreren Regionen an. In Charkiw wurden 22 Menschen verletzt.

items.title: Ukrainian marines cleared about 6 km² near Pokrovsk without losses. The Russians they faced got a can of meat a week
items.teaser: The deputy commander says the operation also yielded a lot of intelligence—and that more surprises await Russia.

items.title: Russians strike Pavlohrad: One injured, cars on fire
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the city of Pavlohrad in Dnipropetrovsk region. Cars in a parking lot caught fire.

items.title: Ukraine expects two EU negotiating clusters to open on 13 October, foreign minister says after talks with Hungary
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has stated following talks with Hungary's Foreign Minister Anita Orbán that he expects the EU to officially decide to open two negotiating clusters on Ukraine's accession to the EU on 13 October.

items.title: Russian attack damages logistics facility in Mykolaiv
items.teaser: Russian drones have attacked Mykolaiv, damaging a logistics facility.

items.title: Ten casualties to one, by a NATO official’s count: Russia’s September in Ukraine’s kill zones
items.teaser: Russia kept sending troops into drone-packed kill zones in September, and up to 28,000 died, a senior NATO official told Bloomberg.

items.title: Zelensky: Ready to work with Rada on election solutions if fighting stops for 60 days
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated his readiness to work with the Verkhovna Rada on legislative changes to hold elections in Ukraine as soon as possible, provided that the U.S. reaches an agreement with Russia on a complete ceasefire lasting at least 60 days.

items.title: Nächster Patzer - Anthropic-KI gibt Fake-Mordhinweis an Polizei
items.teaser: KI-Agent handelt auf eigene Faust und stellt 20 Visa-Anträge

items.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy accuses Russia of ceasefire violations
items.teaser: Less than 24 hours after Donald Trump announced an "energy ceasefire," Ukraine reported Russian strikes on the northeastern city of Kharkiv. The Kremlin says it would only consider a one-day ceasefire for an election.

items.title: Ukraine says Russia launched strikes hours after Donald Trump announced an 'energy ceasefire'
items.teaser: Less than 24 hours after Donald Trump announced an "energy ceasefire," Ukraine reported Russian strikes on the northeastern city of Kharkiv. The Kremlin says it would only consider a one-day ceasefire for an election.

items.title: Russians attack Pavlohrad: man injured, cars catch fire
items.teaser: On 12 October, Russian forces attacked the city of Pavlohrad in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, leaving a man injured and causing cars to catch fire in a car park.

items.title: Fire Point trolls Russia's Yandex after drone attack on data center
items.teaser: The incident follows a series of reported drone strikes on Russian data centers that have disrupted Yandex services.

items.title: Fast 1.600 neue Maßnahmen: Die EU verabschiedet das umfangreichste Sanktionspaket gegen Russland
items.teaser: Die EU-Außenminister haben soeben fast 1.600 neue Sanktionen gegen den russischen Militär-Industrie-Komplex verabschiedet

items.title: Kremlin has nothing to say on Trump's energy ceasefire, rejects Zelensky's truce proposal
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Oct. 12 reiterated his readiness to adhere to the energy truce — provided that Russia follows suit.

items.title: Germany stays in Russia’s sabotage crosshairs, and its industry now braces for the long haul
items.teaser: Companies are no random targets, the country’s main industry lobby warns, a week after the foreign intelligence chief said Germany had become a main obstacle to Russian power in Europe.

items.title: Ukraine passes amendments to education law to secure Hungary's consent for EU accession clusters
items.teaser: Ukrainian MPs have voted to amend education legislation to meet Hungarian requirements and pave the way for the opening of the second and third EU accession negotiating clusters.

items.title: DPRK: Council adds three individuals and four entities to sanctions lists over nuclear, missile programmes and Russia ties
items.teaser: The Council adopted restrictive measures against three individuals and four entities supporting North Korea’s weapons of mass destruction programmes and violating UN sanctions, including through Russia-DPRK cooperation.

items.title: Geheimpapier enthüllt - Putins perfide Terror-Rechnung für die Ukraine
items.teaser: Geheimpapier zeigt Russlands Pläne für Angriffe auf 60 Energieziele der Ukraine.

items.title: US threatens to cut intel sharing with Ukraine in push to protect Russian oil refineries, sources confirm
items.teaser: The Kyiv Independent had learned that the Trump administration had threatened senior Ukrainian military and government officials in a push to protect Russian oil refineries. items.title: Zelensky: Social media feels easier to breathe in after attacks on Yandex
items.teaser: Ukrainian strikes on Yandex data centers in response to Russian attacks on data centers in Ukraine have led to a decrease in the presence of malicious bots on social media.

items.title: NHL legend Dominik Hašek likens Trump-Putin cooperation to 1939 Hitler-Stalin pact
items.teaser: Two-time Stanley Cup winner Dominik Hašek has criticised US President Donald Trump over his diesel agreement with Vladimir Putin, comparing it to the 1939 Hitler-Stalin pact.

items.title: EU imposes sanctions over Russian State Duma "elections" in occupied territories of Ukraine
items.teaser: The Council of the EU has imposed restrictive measures on 77 individuals for their involvement in the illegal "elections" to the Russian State Duma in the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine.

items.title: Hybride Bedrohung: CSU-Politiker Dobrindt spricht von "Schattenkrieg"
items.teaser: Deutschland gerät ins Visier hybrider Angriffe. Innenminister Dobrindt mahnt nun auch innenpolitisch eine Zeitenwende an.

items.title: Russian foreign minister claims Zelenskyy has not earned a ceasefire
items.teaser: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov has confirmed Russia will continue strikes across Ukraine, rejecting US-announced energy ceasefire frameworks.

items.title: Russian assets are only leverage if Europe uses them, says Ukraine's FM Sybiha
items.teaser: "Europe can no longer stay immobilized on Russia's immobilized assets. The leverage is not in holding the money, but in using it for defense," Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said.

items.title: Umfrage der EU-Kommission zu den Exportkontrollpraktiken bei immateriellen Transfers von Gütern mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck (ITT)
items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.teaser: Russia responded to U.S. President Donald Trump’s announcement of an energy truce between Moscow and Kyiv with new attacks on Ukraine’s power grid; however, Ukraine is prepared for such a ceasefire and is sending the appropriate signals.

items.title: Kremlin ready for one-day ceasefire for Ukraine's elections but dismisses 60-day proposal
items.teaser: Dmitry Peskov, press secretary for the Russian leader, has stated that Russia is unwilling to observe a 60-day ceasefire for elections in Ukraine, but Vladimir Putin is supposedly ready to halt strikes only on election day.

items.title: Ukraine's parliament passes minority schools bill to appease Hungary, advance EU talks
items.teaser: The vote paves the way for the EU to formally open two more accession clusters with Ukraine and Moldova at a meeting in Luxembourg on Oct. 13.

items.title: Russia’s supply base in occupied Luhansk Oblast burned overnight—NASA’s fire map caught it
items.teaser: The fires broke out together and grew within the hour, satellite data show, and Ukrainian monitoring channel Exilenova+ reported heavy Ukrainian strikes in the area.

items.title: Russia-led military bloc launches joint military drills in Belarus
items.teaser: The drills involve more than 1,500 military personnel, over 300 pieces of military equipment, and around 80 drones, according to the Collective Security Treaty Organization.

items.title: Russia's Yandex will need six months to replace drone-damaged equipment
items.teaser: Drone strikes on three Yandex data centres have triggered severe server shortages, driving up cloud service tariffs and forcing costly security upgrades.

items.title: Kremlin says consultations on energy ceasefire are still ongoing
items.teaser: The Kremlin says consultations on the energy ceasefire announced by Donald Trump are still ongoing but has declined to say whether the contacts involve the US, Ukraine or both.

items.title: Erinnerung: Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-VO bis 11. September 2026
items.teaser: Vor einigen Wochen haben wir bereits per Newsletter über den Start der Umfragen zur Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung informiert. Da der Start der Umfragen ausgerechnet in die Ferienzeit fiel, möchten wir Sie hiermit erneut an die Umfragen erinnern.

items.title: Vorankündigung des 18. Informationstags Exportkontrolle
items.teaser: Der Informationstag Exportkontrolle (ITE) wird am 10. Dezember 2026 in Frankfurt am Main stattfinden.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag in Berlin eröffnet
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag ist heute in Berlin eröffnet worden. Unter dem Leitthema „Exportkontrolle in der Balance?“ diskutieren heute und morgen Vertreterinnen und Vertreter aus Politik, Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und internationalen Partnerorganisationen aktuelle Entwicklungen der Exportkontrolle.

items.title: Three injured in Russian drone attack on Kyiv
items.teaser: Three people were injured in Kyiv in a Russian drone attack on 12 October. Drone debris fell on a house in the Darnytskyi district and near residential buildings in the Solomianskyi district.

items.title: Russischer Angriff in Region Donezk: Eine Person getötet, 18 Zivilisten verletzt
items.teaser: Die russischen Angreifer hätten am 11. Oktober einen Menschen in der Region Donezk getötet.

items.title: Exclusive: Finland pushes to all but eliminate Russian travel in EU
items.teaser: "The Kremlin must see that continued aggression will deepen its isolation. I ask you to take these proposals forward as an urgent priority," writes Finnish Foreign Minister Elina Valtonen in a letter seen by the Kyiv Independent.

items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has questioned Donald Trump's diesel agreement with Vladimir Putin, stating Ukraine holds effective leverage over Russian oil shipments and refineries.

items.title: Klitschko: Drone debris falls on private home in Kyiv's Darnytskyi district
items.teaser: In Kyiv’s Darnytskyi district, debris from a Russian drone fell on a private home.

items.title: Russian attacks kill at least 10, injure 73 across Ukraine as Moscow targets energy infrastructure in several oblasts
items.teaser: Overnight on Oct. 12, Russian forces launched 121 Shahed-type attack drones, including 76 jet-powered versions, as well as Gerbera and Parodiya decoy drones, Ukraine's Air Force said.

items.title: Dobrindt: "Schattenkrieg" soll Deutschland destabilisieren
items.teaser: Sabotage, Spionage, Cyberattacken: Der Innenminister warnt vor einer neuen Bedrohung, die weit über den Kalten Krieg hinausgehe.

items.title: Grandson killed in action, grandmother in her home: Russians kill maths teacher in Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: Beloved Zaporizhzhia educator Bronislava Tumanska has been killed in her home during a Russian attack, months after her grandson was killed on the front lines.

items.title: Government defers UAH 39 bln in payments to year end — Marchenko
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers has pushed back payments worth about UAH 39 billion to the end of 2026 and suspended VAT refunds totaling UAH 18 billion.

items.title: EU sanctions nearly 1,600 people linked to Russia's military industry
items.teaser: EU foreign ministers have sanctioned nearly 1,600 people linked to Russia's military-industrial complex, with more than half connected to ballistic missile production.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 264 Gefechte an der Front, Mehrheit davon Richtung Pokrowsk und Kostjantyniwka
items.teaser: Am 11. Oktober kam es zu 264 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.teaser: Hinweise zum Anmeldestart

items.title: Ausfuhrkontrolle: Bundesregierung vereinfacht Ausfuhr von bestimmten Rüstungsgütern an die Golfstaaten und die Ukraine
items.teaser: Die befristete Allgemeine Genehmigung für die Lieferung von Gütern der Luft- und maritimen Verteidigung ist zum 20. März 2026 in Kraft getreten.

items.title: Anpassung der Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für Ausfuhren nach Russland
items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.

items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag findet im Juni in Berlin statt.

items.title: FM Sybiha: We should avoid premature or emotional assessments of U.S. statements
items.teaser: Ukraine is keeping a cool head, while statements from the United States may be influenced by preparations for the November 3 midterm congressional elections.

items.title: Konferenz in Berlin - Bundesamt für Verfassungsschutz sieht langfristig angelegten hybriden Angriff Russlands auf Deutschland
items.teaser: Das Bundesamt für Verfassungsschutz rechnet mit weiteren hybriden Angriffen und Destabilisierungsversuchen durch Russland.

items.title: 'We have one refinery' — Zelensky says energy ceasefire must cover power grid, not just oil
items.teaser: Ukraine will halt its strikes against Russian refineries only if Moscow ceases its attacks against the Ukrainian power grid, President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Oct. 12, signaling that a refinery-only truce makes little sense for a country with a single, badly damaged refinery.

items.title: Polish PM: Those who say Ukraine is responsible for the war are giving a valuable gift to Putin
items.teaser: Speaking at the Warsaw Security Forum, Donald Tusk has emphasised Russia's full responsibility for the war, warning that blaming Ukraine benefits Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Zelenskyy: We are ready to sign guarantees for the Americans regarding the energy ceasefire
items.teaser: Addressing the Warsaw Security Forum, President Zelenskyy has confirmed Ukraine is ready to sign written guarantees for an energy truce if Russia complies.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Russia preparing numerous aggressive hybrid operations against Europe, against your countries
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Russia is planning numerous aggressive hybrid operations against European countries and urges Europe not to underestimate the threats.

items.title: Selenskyj: Angriffe auf Kraftwerk trotz "Energie-Waffenruhe"
items.teaser: Nach Donald Trumps Ankündigung einer "Energie-Waffenruhe" meldet Kiew russische Angriffe auf Energieanlagen. Die EU erhöhte unterdessen den Druck auf Russland mit neuen Sanktionen.

items.title: Ukraine simplifies logging procedures for defense and fortification works in border regions
items.teaser: The Cabinet of Ministers has simplified logging procedures for defense and fortification purposes in border regions; from now on, defense forces will be able to quickly create natural barriers and clearings without delays caused by bureaucratic approvals.

items.title: Zelenskyy: If Russia wants us to stop hitting refineries, it must stop strikes on our energy system
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that halting long-range strikes on Russian oil exports requires Russia to cease targeting Ukraine's energy system and civilian infrastructure.

items.title: Angriffe trotz "Energie-Waffenruhe" in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Nach seinem Diesel-Deal mit Russland hat US-Präsident Trump eine "Energie-Waffenruhe" zwischen Kyjiw und Moskau verkündet. Doch nur wenige Stunden später gibt es neue Angriffe auf ukrainische Energieanlagen.

items.title: Wieder Huthi-Terror: Erneut saudischer Flughafen attackiert
EU passes sanctions against Russia's illegal election in occupied Ukrainian territories
items.teaser: Of the 77 sanctioned individuals, 74 ran as candidates in the sham elections, while the remaining three were newly elected members of Russia's central electoral commission.

items.title: Brand auf Krim-Flugplatz Hwardijske
items.teaser: Auf der vorübergehend besetzten Krim wird ein Brand auf dem Flugplatz „Hwardijske“ gemeldet.

items.title: S. Petersohn, ARD Kiew, B. Blaschke, ARD Moskau zzt. Köln, zu Trumps "Energie-Waffenruhe"
items.teaser: S. Petersohn, ARD Kiew, B. Blaschke, ARD Moskau zzt. Köln, zu Trumps "Energie-Waffenruhe"

items.title: Defense Forces destroy workshop and warehouse storing UAVs and EW equipment in Donetsk region
items.teaser: Pilots from the 237th Separate Unmanned Systems Battalion of the 7th Corps of the Ukrainian Armed Forces’ Airborne Assault Troops, in coordination with other units, destroyed a workshop and warehouse containing Russian drones and electronic warfare equipment in the Donetsk region.

items.title: Russian attack on Dnipro kills one person, sparks fire at shopping centre
items.teaser: A Russian attack on Dnipro killed one person on 12 October, while a separate strike on Dnipro district caused a fire at a shopping centre.

items.title: Short on interceptors, Ukraine goes after the launchers: eight Russian ballistic systems hit, three destroyed since September, a minister says
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Minister says the hits made Moscow rework planned barrages, as he presses partners for anti-ballistic missiles in bulk instead of one-off deliveries.

items.title: Lithuania calls on EU to recognise Russian military intelligence as terrorist organisation
items.teaser: Speaking in Luxembourg, Lithuanian Foreign Minister Kęstutis Budrys has urged the EU to formally list Russia's GRU as a terrorist organisation over its widespread sabotage operations in Europe.

items.title: EU votes through largest ever Russia sanctions list
items.teaser: "This is the single largest expansion of our sanctions list since Russia started its war," chief EU diplomat Kaja Kallas said, adding that more than half of the roughly 1600 listings "are connected to the production chain for ballistic missiles."

items.title: Lithuania calls on EU to designate Russia's foreign intelligence agency a terrorist organization
items.teaser: "Only when we increase our sanctions, when we show that we are serious, will we deny Russia the possibility to raise havoc in our capitals," Budrys said.

items.title: Russians attacks railway in Zhytomyr Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces have launched repeated attacks on railway infrastructure in the Korosten district of Zhytomyr Oblast, according to Ukrainian emergency services.

items.title: Russian UAV strike hits high-rise building in Kharkiv, injuring 11 people
items.teaser: In Kharkiv, a Russian attack drone struck a high-rise building on the morning of October 12.

items.title: EU should 'hold a mirror to itself' on Russia sanctions before criticizing others — Latvian minister on Trump diesel deal
items.teaser: "Let's look at ourselves. The EU first took out two big Russian oligarchs, the biggest ever supporters of Putin's regime, from the sanctions," Latvia's Foreign Minister Baiba Braze said when asked to comment on a U.S. deal to buy Russian diesel.

Polish foreign minister urges NATO to prepare for possibility of casualties from Russian actions in Europe
items.teaser: Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski says NATO must be prepared for the possibility that Russia's growing hybrid activities in Europe could result in loss of life.

items.title: Ex-BND-Präsident in U-Haft - VERRATEN UND VERKAUFT?
items.teaser: Ex-BND-Chef sitzt wegen Spionageverdachts in Untersuchungshaft.

items.title: EU have not yet seen Russia comply with the energy ceasefire
items.teaser: EU High Representative Kaja Kallas has stated Brussels has not seen Russia honour the energy ceasefire announced by Donald Trump, urging stronger sanctions.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,554,310 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,470 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 89 russische Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 89 Drohnen neutralisiert, mit denen Russland seit Sonntagabend, dem 11. Oktober, das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: EU chief diplomat responds to Trump's call: Ukraine needs ceasefire to hold elections
items.teaser: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas says elections cannot be held in Ukraine while the war continues and that international pressure should focus on Russia to end the war.

items.title: "Russlands Hauptproblem 2026 sind die Europäer"
items.teaser: Europas Unterstützung ist aus Sicht von Russland-Expertin Hanna Notte entscheidend für die Ukraine. Trumps Diesel-Deal mit Russland nennt sie einen "politischen Coup" für Putin.

items.title: Power outage schedules in effect in some regions on Monday
items.teaser: In certain regions of Ukraine, electricity consumption will be restricted from 6:00 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. on Monday, October 12.

items.title: EU-Außenminister beraten über größte Sanktionsrunde gegen Russland
items.teaser: Es geht um mehr als 1.600 Personen und Organisationen: Die EU-Außenminister beraten heute über neue Sanktionen wegen des russischen Angriffskrieges gegen die Ukraine. Deutliche Kritik gibt es am Vorgehen der USA. Von Tina Hassel.

items.title: Merz's party says EU should encourage Ukraine to keep striking Russian oil refineries
items.teaser: CDU politician Roderich Kiesewetter says Europe should encourage Ukraine to continue striking Russian oil refineries, calling them legitimate military targets.

items.title: Ukrainian defence intelligence discloses details of Russian Kinzhal aeroballistic missile
items.teaser: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine has published a 3D model and detailed technical breakdown of Russia's Kh-47M2 Kinzhal missile and its manufacturers.

items.title: Ukraine reports 264 frontline clashes in past 24 hours, with heaviest fighting in Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka sectors
items.teaser: Over the past day, on October 11, 264 clashes between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded on the front lines.

items.title: Russians strike business in Pavlohrad
items.teaser: Regional officials have reported damage to a company in Pavlohrad following a Russian attack, though full details on casualties remain under assessment.

items.title: Laut Carney steht Vereinbarung über Kauf von russischem Diesel dem Frieden in der Ukraine im Wege
items.teaser: Das Abkommen zwischen den USA und Russland über die Lieferung von russischem Dieselkraftstoff auf die Weltmärkte verhindere den Frieden in der Ukraine.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times since evening, causing damage
items.teaser: Russian invaders have attacked three districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times, resulting in damage to civilian facilities and fires.

items.title: Russian Shahed destroys several floors of building in Kharkiv, injuring people
items.teaser: Kharkiv Mayor Ihor Terekhov has reported five injuries and structural damage from the 6th to 8th floors following a Russian drone strike on a residential building.

items.title: Ukrainian air defence downs 89 Russian drones, including 55 jet-powered
items.teaser: Russia launched 121 drones and a Kh-59 air-to-surface missile overnight, with impacts recorded at 15 locations and debris falling at four others.

items.title: Russians strike postal operator's logistics facilities in Odesa Oblast
items.teaser: A Russian attack damaged a building's facade, windows and equipment in southern Odesa Oblast. No injuries have been reported.

items.title: Russian strikes damage homes, warehouses and port terminal in Mykolaiv region
items.teaser: In Ochakiv, Mykolaiv region, a 54-year-old woman was injured as a result of a Russian “Banderole” strike.

items.title: Bundesverband der Deutschen Industrie - Warnung vor zunehmender russischer Sabotage gegen Industrieunternehmen
items.teaser: ​Der Bundesverband der Deutschen Industrie warnt vor einer wachsenden Gefahr durch ‌russische Sabotageakte ⁠gegen heimische ⁠Unternehmen.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 1470 weiteren Angreifern und zwei Luftabwehrsystemen
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 12. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.554.310 Soldaten. Innerhalb eines Tages wurden 1930 weitere Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Russian Banderol strike on Izium overnight injures one person and damages infrastructure
items.teaser: Overnight, the enemy struck Izyum in the Kharkiv region with “Banderol” munitions; one person was injured, and power lines and homes were damaged.

items.title: Die juristische Presseschau vom 10. bis 12. Oktober 2026: Friedensnobelpreis für Völkerrechtlerin / USA verhängen Sanktionen gegen IStGH / BVerfG vor Verhandlungen zur Erbschaftsteuer
items.teaser: Die frühere IStGH-Richterin Navanethem Pillay erhält den Friedensnobelpreis. Die USA verhängen Sanktionen gegen den gesamten Internationalen Strafgerichtshof. Das BVerfG verhandelt am Montag und am Dienstag über das Erbschaftsteuerrecht.

items.title: Russian forces lose another 1,470 soldiers and two air defense systems in war against Ukraine over past day
items.teaser: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine—from February 24, 2022, through October 12, 2026—amount to approximately 1,554,310 people, including 1,470 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Kremlin claims Trump wants Zelenskyy replaced because he is not making "difficult decisions"
items.teaser: Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov says Ukraine needs a leader willing to make difficult decisions to bring the war to an end, echoing Trump's recent remarks.

items.title: USF units have killed more than 100,000 Russian troops since start of year
items.teaser: Since the beginning of 2026, units of the Unmanned Systems Forces have killed and wounded more than 100,000 Russian occupiers.

items.title: Russia and its allies begin military exercises in Belarus
items.teaser: More than 1,500 troops and over 300 pieces of military equipment are taking part in the drills, which include peacekeeping operations and measures to address biological threats.

items.title: Extremismus im Klassenzimmer: Wie Lehramtsbewerber in Sachsen, Sachsen-Anhalt und Thüringen auf Verfassungstreue überprüft werden
items.teaser: In Sachsen wurde die Tochter von Götz Kubitschek als Lehramtsbewerberin abgelehnt. Ob der Verfassungsschutz in solchen Fällen eingeschaltet wird, ist in Sachsen, Sachsen-Anhalt und Thüringen unterschiedlich geregelt.

items.title: Downed Shahed drones and recovered Western microelectronics to be displayed at Warsaw Security Forum
items.teaser: On October 13, the Russian “Shahed” attack drone and Western microelectronics seized from downed Russian drones will be presented at the Warsaw Security Forum.

items.title: FM Sybiha discusses increasing pressure on Russia with German FM
items.teaser: On Sunday, Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha discussed with his German counterpart, Johann Wadephul, the packed agenda for tomorrow’s European talks and key decisions on stepping up pressure on Russia.

items.title: Russia loses 1,470 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,470 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Liashko: Russia seeks to deprive Ukrainians of access to essential medicines
items.teaser: Over the past month, Russia has stepped up attacks on pharmaceutical warehouses, production facilities and storage sites for critically important medicines, seeking to make it harder for Ukrainians to access the drugs and treatment they need.

items.title: Strikes on Yandex data centres disrupt over 80 Russian services
items.teaser: Three Ukrainian drone attacks on Yandex data centres disrupted more than 80 digital services, while bot traffic from the company's network fell to almost zero.

items.title: Russia lost over 50,000 soldiers in September, Bloomberg reports
items.teaser: Inflicting heavy personnel losses has become a stated strategic objective of Ukraine. In January, then-Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov said Ukraine aimed to "kill 50,000 Russians per month," arguing that losses on that scale could undermine Moscow's ability to sustain the war.

items.title: NATO believes Europe must step up support for Ukraine to deter Putin – Bloomberg
items.teaser: Speaking at the Warsaw Security Forum, General Alexus Grynkewich has emphasised that boosting support for Ukraine is essential to counter Russian sabotage and cyberattacks.

items.title: Ukrainian forces destroy two Russian boats with personnel on board
items.teaser: Ukrainian defenders have destroyed two boats belonging to Russian invaders, along with the personnel on board.

items.title: UK PM calls Russian interference in 2016 Brexit referendum obvious
items.teaser: Andy Burnham says he was given a clear answer that Moscow interfered in the 2016 EU referendum, while a pro-Brexit group disputes claims that Russian activity affected the result.

items.title: Search and rescue operations completed at site of Russian guided bomb strike in Zaporizhzhia: 20 killed, including four children
items.teaser: Search and rescue operations have been completed at the site of a Russian strike on a residential building in Zaporizhzhia. Twenty people were killed, including four children.

items.title: 3 killed, 25 injured in Russian strike near Kharkiv
items.teaser: Among those killed were a 16-year-old boy, as well as a 19-year-old woman, and a 51-year-old woman, authorities said, in a strike that landed near a grocery store as well as several residential buildings.

items.title: Warhead of Russian ballistic missile recovered among residential buildings in Kyiv's Obolonskyi district
items.teaser: Explosive ordnance disposal specialists from Ukraine's State Emergency Service recovered the warhead of a Russian ballistic missile in Kyiv's Obolonskyi District.

items.title: Russia's September casualties in war against Ukraine exceeded 50,000 – Bloomberg citing NATO
items.teaser: A NATO military official says around 28,000 Russian troops were killed last month, while Ukraine's defence forces suffered approximately 5,000 casualties over the same period.

items.title: Estonian volunteers deliver 13 vehicles to Ukraine’s Defense Forces in Zhytomyr
items.teaser: On October 10, Estonian volunteers handed over 13 vehicles to Ukraine’s Defense Forces in Zhytomyr.

items.title: EU to provide Ukraine with 3 billion euro tranche of military funding this week
items.teaser: The European Union is set to disburse approximately 3 billion euros ($4.8 billion) of defense support to Ukraine this week as part of the bloc's 90 billion euro support loan ($100 billion) for Kyiv, President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Oct. 11.

items.title: Von der Leyen announces additional funding for Ukraine's "drones and missiles"
items.teaser: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has announced new funding for Ukrainian drones and missiles to strengthen air defences against Russian attacks.

items.title: Russian occupation authorities abandon plans to restore 80 damaged apartment buildings in Siverskodonetsk
items.teaser: The Russian occupation authorities have abandoned plans to restore 80 damaged apartment buildings in Siverskodonetsk.

items.title: Senators' statement: US "should not provide Putin with a financial lifeline"
items.teaser: Seven senators from both parties say the move conflicts with a 2022 law banning Russian energy imports and urge the administration to reverse its decision.

items.title: International Criminal Court: Statement by the High Representative on behalf of the EU following the announcement of US sanctions
items.teaser: International Criminal Court: Statement by the High Representative on behalf of the EU following the announcement of US sanctions.

items.title: Russian missile strike on Kharkiv suburbs: Three dead, injury toll rises 22
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian missile strike on the suburbs of Kharkiv has risen to 22, while three people were killed.

items.title: Russian forces attack energy facility in Kharkiv suburbs
items.teaser: Russian troops attacked an energy facility in the suburbs of Kharkiv late on Sunday.

items.title: Russian drone strike kills 3 service members in Ivano-Frankivsk, wounds 3 others
items.teaser: The attack was the latest in a series targeting the western Ukrainian city, with strikes reported on three days within a four-day period.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1691: Ukraine opens arms exports to 18 makers as defense output hits $55 billion
items.teaser: Trump announced an immediate energy ceasefire, which Zelenskyy said was news to him.

items.title: Ukraine imposes sanctions on Russian ballistic missile manufacturers
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has signed decrees enacting decisions of the National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine to impose sanctions on a number of additional individuals and legal entities.

items.title: Axios: Trump's "energy ceasefire" would cover only attacks on oil refineries
items.teaser: A White House official says Washington expects Kyiv and Moscow to stop striking each other's refineries first, with a possible agreement on power plants and energy grids to follow.

items.title: Russland greift trotz angeblicher "Energie-Waffenruhe" weiter Anlagen an
items.teaser: Russland hat erneut Energieanlagen angegriffen. Die Attacken erfolgten nach der Verkündung einer "Energie-Waffenruhe" zwischen Kiew und Moskau durch US-Präsident Trump - die bislang von beiden Seiten nicht bestätigt wurde.

items.title: Polizei warnt vor Anschlag auf polnischen Regierungschef Tusk
items.teaser: Noch ist vieles im Unklaren, aber die Sorge scheint groß. Offenbar hat die polnische Polizei konkrete Hinweise auf Anschlagspläne auf Regierungschef Tusk und Verteidigungsminister Kosiniak-Kamysz. Ein Mann wurde festgenommen.

items.title: Drones now cause about 96% of Russia’s battlefield losses. Ukraine’s drone force says it has hit more than 100,000 Russian troops this year alone
items.teaser: That is more than 150,000 since the Unmanned Systems Forces was created.

items.title: US threatens to halt weapons procurement for Ukraine over strikes on Russian energy sites, FT reports
items.teaser: The reported pressure preceded President Donald Trump’s announcement on Oct. 11 that Moscow and Kyiv had agreed to stop attacks on each other’s energy infrastructure.

items.title: Zelensky briefs von der Leyen on Russian strikes on energy infrastructure after Trump's ceasefire announcement
items.teaser: During a phone call with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, President Volodymyr Zelensky reported Russian strikes on Ukraine's energy infrastructure that had been recorded after U.S. President Donald Trump's announcement of an energy ceasefire.

items.title: Zelensky comments on possibility of holding elections in Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said Ukraine will hold elections if Russia agrees to a 60-day ceasefire.

items.title: Ukraine's foreign minister: Russia violated "energy ceasefire" immediately after it was announced
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha says Moscow attacked critical energy infrastructure facilities hours after Donald Trump announced an immediate halt to strikes on energy facilities.

items.title: Drohungen - Verdächtiger nach mutmaßlichen Anschlagsplänen auf polnischen Regierungschef sowie Verteidigungsminister festgenommen
items.teaser: Nach Hinweisen zu Anschlagsplänen auf den polnischen Regierungschef Tusk und Verteidigungsminister Kosiniak-Kamysz ist ein Verdächtiger festgenommen worden.

items.title: Khmara: Ukraine hit eight Russian ballistic missile launchers in September and early October
items.teaser: Ukraine critically lacks ballistic missile interceptors, making asymmetric responses, including strikes on Russian launchers, necessary. In September and early October, Ukraine's Defense Forces struck eight launchers used for ballistic missile attacks.

items.title: Fears that Ukraine will lose Starlink are back after Musk backed Trump against Zelenskyy. Adviser says profit makes cutoff unlikely
items.teaser: Serhii “Flash” Beskrestnov says Musk is first of all a businessman, and Ukraine brings SpaceX significant profit, so he is sure no one will switch it off.

items.title: Three killed in Russian drone attack on Ivano-Frankivsk
items.teaser: Three people have been killed in a Russian drone attack on Ivano-Frankivsk.

items.title: Zelenskyy imposes sanctions on Russian ballistic missile makers and two other groups
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has enacted three sanctions packages targeting people and companies involved in Russia's ballistic missile production, financial sanctions evasion and activities in occupied Ukrainian territories.

items.title: tagesschau 20:00 Uhr
items.teaser: CDU berät in Präsidiumsklausur über Wege aus der Krise, Krieg in der Golfregion: Tote bei Angriff auf Flughafen von Riad, Trump verkündet "Energie-Waffenruhe" zwischen Kiew und Moskau, Jurist und Autor Philippe Sands erhält den Friedenspreis des Deutschen Buchhandels, Festnahme in Polen nach geplantem Anschlag auf Regi

items.title: Zelensky announces meetings with European leaders, new support packages
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced meetings and other engagements with European leaders next week to consolidate support, as well as new aid packages.

items.title: Russia is building jet drones that fly 800 kilometers per hour, and Ukraine says it is already working on how to stop next generation
items.teaser: Russia’s jet-powered Gerans fly several times faster than the propeller Shaheds and remain the main challenge for air defense.

items.title: FT: US threatens to halt arms supplies to Ukraine under PURL programme
items.teaser: European officials say Washington is pressuring Kyiv and European capitals to stop long-range attacks on Russian energy infrastructure facilities, with threats to suspend intelligence sharing and the PURL weapons procurement mechanism.

items.title: 'To keep oil prices from rising' — Russian lawmaker questions Trump’s energy ceasefire claim
items.teaser: "We all know that Trump often says things to keep oil prices from rising," Igor Ananskikh, first deputy chair of the committee, told Russian outlet Ostorozhno Novosti.

items.title: Ukrainian army receives relevant orders following Trump's statement on energy ceasefire – Zelensky
items.teaser: The Ukrainian Armed Forces have received the relevant orders following U.S. President Donald Trump's statement that an energy ceasefire has been reached.

items.title: Russian invaders strike Kharkiv suburb with missiles, killing three, injuring nine
items.teaser: Russian forces have launched a missile strike on a suburb of Kharkiv, killing three people and injuring nine others.
